name: Lesotho
summary: Blue, white and green horizontal bands with a black mokorotlo, the traditional Basotho conical straw hat, in the centre. Adopted in 2006 for the 40th anniversary of independence.
origin: At independence in 1966 Lesotho's flag was blue with a white mokorotlo and green and red stripes. A military government replaced it in 1987 with a flag showing a shield, assegai and knobkerrie.
On 4 October 2006, the 40th anniversary of independence, a new flag was introduced with a peaceful symbol: the mokorotlo alone.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: The mokorotlo; the Basotho nation, an African state.

symbols.name: Mokorotlo
symbols.description: A black conical straw hat with a knob on top.
symbols.meaning: The Basotho people and their culture; the hat's shape is said to resemble Mount Qiloane.

facts: Lesotho is entirely surrounded by South Africa.
It is the only independent state lying entirely above 1,000 metres.
The mokorotlo also appears on Lesotho's licence plates.
clues: Blue, white and green bands with a black conical hat in the centre.
Its hat is said to resemble a mountain.
Adopted in 2006 to replace a flag showing weapons.
